subject.name: St. Thérèse of Lisieux
subject.blurb: French Carmelite nun whose “little way” taught holiness through ordinary acts done with trust and love. Her spiritual autobiography, Story of a Soul, spread her teaching around the world, and Pope John Paul II named her a Doctor of the Church in 1997.
subject.notification: St. Thérèse of Lisieux, pray for us!
